concept: Thailand-specific re-shoot of the canonical value_prop boarding moment. Replaces the generic southeast_asia urban plate so the Grab Thailand deck's slide 2 is recognizably Bangkok. DISTINCT from slide 3 (wide karst-bay establishing shot) and from the cover (Andaman flagship hero).
scene: Bangkok Chao Phraya riverfront; professional woman lower-left, phone in hand, walking to the dock to board; canonical N30 bow-to-dock with gangway down; recognizable Bangkok skyline + gilded temple spire (Wat Arun-style) mid-ground; right third kept calm.
reference_images: deck-studio/assets/n30/n30-reference-neutral.png (vessel FORM+COLOR only; slide-3 plate deliberately NOT used as a composition reference)

differentiation_from_slide3.locale: Bangkok urban riverfront vs wild karst bay
differentiation_from_slide3.framing: intimate three-quarter boarding moment vs wide landscape
differentiation_from_slide3.mood: morning commuter / on-demand vs scenic leisure

n30_lighting_rule: vessel generated neutral/daylight; scene sets time-of-day. IMAGE-RULES.md.

scrim.helper: deterministic PIL navy lower-third gradient (canonical value_prop recipe, matched to grab-value_prop_bg-southeast_asia)
scrim.note: the live slide also carries a full-slide navy scrim shape (#0A1220 @ alpha 0.5) under the text; that shape is unchanged and not part of this asset.
